info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Update Correspondence Details API
info.description: This API is designed to update the details of existing correspondence documents within the banking system. Users can modify attributes associated with a specific correspondence identified by its ID. Typical consumers of this API include bank staff and system administrators who manage customer communications and documentation. Enhancing correspondence entries ensures that the information remains accurate and relevant, ultimately improving customer service and operational efficiency.

patch.summary: Update the correspondence document with the specified ID.
patch.description: This operation allows you to update details of a specific correspondence document identified by its ID. Make sure to provide the necessary fields in the request body to reflect the changes you want to apply.

requestBody.description: This request body allows the client to update specific fields of the correspondence document identified by RES-100045. The content must be formatted as a JSON object that includes the fields to be updated, adhering to the defined schema.
